[b][i][color=#ff00ff][size=5]And then I said , “Your trunk is misaligned, hahaha” and everyone fell silent without looking me in the eye... It was uncomfortable...[/size][/color][/i][/b]


[size=4]This mod is pretty straightforward; it fixes a bug in the rendering of trees on very large maps, approximately at coordinate X: 200. This bug causes the stump and the aerial part of the tree to be clearly misaligned. It is only visual and does not affect the mechanics, but it can be annoying. [/size]


[color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]And that's it, there are no settings or i18n, it's purely functional.[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]

Downloads.Description:
Unzip and install like any other mod. If you like the mod don't forget to hit the 'Endorse' button at the top of this page, it helps me a lot and it's free :D

Be sure to stop by later, you're important to me <3
